description: Audit an MCP server by launching it over stdio: initialize handshake, protocol version, server info, tools/list quality (names, descriptions, inputSchema validity, undescribed parameters), response times, and error handling on a deliberately bad tool call. Returns a scored report (0-100) with named, evidence-backed issues.

command.description: Server launch command, e.g. npx or node

env.description: Extra environment variables for the server process

name: audit_server
